definitions.explanation: Relating to an individual's personal matters or private life, as opposed to public or official matters.

examples.japanese: これは{私的|してき}な{問題|もんだい}だ。
{私的|してき}な{時間|じかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしたい。
examples.english: I want to value my private time.

examples.japanese: {私的|してき}に{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went on a personal trip.

notes:
{私的|してき} is a na-adjective meaning private or personal, contrasting with anything public or official. It is relatively formal and often appears in written or semi-formal speech.

FORMS:
- {私的|してき}な + noun: private (modifier)
- {私的|してき}に: privately, personally (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私的|してき}な{問題|もんだい}: a private matter
- {私的|してき}な{理由|りゆう}: personal reasons
- {私的|してき}な{時間|じかん}: personal/private time
- {私的|してき}な{旅行|りょこう}: a personal trip

NOTE ON READING:
Same reading as {指摘|してき} (pointing out) — completely different words. Context usually makes the meaning clear.

CONTRAST:
- {公的|こうてき}: public, official (antonym)
- {個人的|こじんてき}: personal (more common in everyday speech than {私的|してき})
